subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw approve these specific revisions of the GitHub App-token, Codex, Docker, and related workflow actions that run in credential-bearing jobs?
rationale: The patch is a mechanical Dependabot update, but whether updated third-party executable action code is acceptable in workflows with repository and provider credentials is a repository security-boundary decision rather than a repair Codex can make.

options.title: Approve reviewed revisions
options.body: A workflow/security owner reviews the upstream action changes and explicitly accepts the updated immutable pins for the affected privileged jobs.

options.title: Split or defer sensitive actions
options.body: Keep routine action updates separate and defer the token-, Codex-, or registry-credential-bearing revisions until their upstream changes receive dedicated review.

options.title: Close and regenerate later
options.body: Close this Dependabot batch if maintaining a broad privileged-action update is not worthwhile, then accept narrower reviewed updates later.

recommendation.title: Approve reviewed revisions
recommendation.body: A workflow/security owner reviews the upstream action changes and explicitly accepts the updated immutable pins for the affected privileged jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: The current timeline is the only concrete human routing signal for this security-sensitive workflow update.
